user_query: Analyze keyword density of blog posts and fetch sitemap XML for SEO improvement.

TaskList.description: Analyze the keyword density of the blog posts to identify the most frequently used keywords and phrases.
Fetch the sitemap XML of the website to extract URLs along with category and breadcrumb information.
Consolidate the results from the keyword density analysis and the sitemap information to provide comprehensive SEO recommendations.
TaskList.dependency: Step 1 and Step 2 need to be completed before this step.
